'''''The American Statistician''''' is a quarterly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering [[statistics]] published by [[Taylor & Francis]] on behalf of the [[American Statistical Association]]. It was established in 1947. The [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Minge Xie]], a professor at the [[Rutgers University]].
